newsitem.title: USA: Rohr to receive $3.5 mln in settlement.
newsitem.headline: Rohr to receive $3.5 mln in settlement.

text.p: Rohr Inc on Tuesday said it finalized an agreement to settle claims against the U.S. Navy related to the E3/E6 program.
In a statement, the company said the settlement, which aggregated $3.5 million, will be reflected in its results for the fiscal third quarter of 1997.
The settlement related to claims that the company filed in connection with alleged changes in government quality-assurance inspections in the late 1980s.

The company said it was diligently pursuing the resolution of those claims and other contractual items with its customers and was successful in resolving several issues during the past several months.

The company said it was still pursuing claims related to redefined acceptance criteria on the Grumman F-14 program which is currently pending a decision from the Armed Services Board of Contract Appeals.
